mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` ( trading_order_no, payment_status, amount, refund, is_refund, member_id, project_id, elder_id, estimated_arrival_time, mark, reason, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark, view_status, order_no, o_create_type ) VALUES ( #{tradingOrderNo}, #{paymentStatus}, #{amount}, #{refund}, #{isRefund}, #{memberId}, #{projectId}, #{elderId}, #{estimatedArrivalTime}, #{mark}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{remark}, #{viewStatus}, #{orderNo}, #{oCreateType} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.amount, o.status, o.payment_status, o.trading_order_no, o.estimated_arrival_time, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.remark, o.reason, e.name AS elder_name, e.bed_number, np.name AS project_name, np.image AS project_image, np.unit AS project_unit, m.name AS member_name, m.phone AS member_phone, u.real_name AS task_creator, nt.update_time AS task_update_time, nt.mark AS task_mark, nt.task_image, rr.refund_status, rr.refund_amount, rr.refund_msg, rr.memo AS refund_memo, rr.create_time AS refund_create_time, rr.update_time AS refund_update_time, t.place_order_json, t.update_time AS trading_update_time FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN elder e ON o.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN nursing_project np ON o.project_id = np.id LEFT JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN nursing_task nt ON o.order_no = nt.rel_no AND nt.task_type = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON nt.create_by = u.id LEFT JOIN refund_record rr ON o.order_no = rr.product_order_no LEFT JOIN trading t ON o.trading_order_no = t.trading_order_no WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT id, trading_order_no, payment_status, amount, refund, is_refund, member_id, project_id, elder_id, estimated_arrival_time, mark, reason, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark, view_status, order_no, o_create_type FROM `order` WHERE id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, amount = #{amount}, refund = #{refund}, is_refund = #{isRefund}, status = #{status}, reason = #{reason}, mark = #{mark}, remark = #{remark}, view_status = #{viewStatus}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, o_create_type = #{oCreateType} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, trading_order_no, payment_status, amount, refund, is_refund, member_id, project_id, elder_id, estimated_arrival_time, mark, reason, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark, view_status, order_no, o_create_type FROM `order` WHERE trading_order_no = #{tradingOrderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET view_status = '1', update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, status = '4' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `order` SET status = '4', payment_status = '3', update_time = NOW(), o_create_type = '2' WHERE id = #{orderId}
UPDATE `order` SET status = '4', payment_status = '3', update_time = NOW(), o_create_type = '2' WHERE status = '0' AND payment_status = '1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, NOW()) > 15

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.amount, o.status, o.payment_status, o.trading_order_no, o.estimated_arrival_time, o.create_time, e.name AS elder_name, e.bed_number, np.name AS project_name, np.image AS project_image, m.name AS member_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN elder e ON o.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN nursing_project np ON o.project_id = np.id LEFT JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.create_by = u.id
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_record (refund_no, product_order_no, refund_amount, refund_status, memo, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{refundNo}, #{productOrderNo}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundStatus}, #{memo}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT rr.id, rr.refund_no AS refundNo, rr.product_order_no AS orderNo, rr.refund_amount AS refundAmount, rr.refund_status AS refundStatus, rr.refund_msg AS refundMsg, rr.memo, rr.create_time AS createTime, rr.update_time AS updateTime, o.amount AS orderAmount, o.status AS orderStatus, e.name AS elderName, np.name AS projectName FROM refund_record rr INNER JOIN `order` o ON rr.product_order_no = o.order_no LEFT JOIN elder e ON o.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN nursing_project np ON o.project_id = np.id WHERE rr.refund_no = #{refundRecordNo} LIMIT 1
